notes:
SCOPE NOTE:
{算数|さんすう} specifically refers to elementary school mathematics (grades 1-6 in Japan). From middle school onward, mathematics is called ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {算数|さんすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ (arithmetic class)
- {算数|さんすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (arithmetic problem)
- {算数|さんすう}⟦ドリル→ドリル：11148_doriru⟧ (arithmetic workbook/drill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧ - mathematics (middle school and beyond, more advanced)
- ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧ - calculation (the act of computing)
